alphabet.name: Arabic Alphabet (Abjad)
alphabet.letters: ا ب ت ث ج ح خ د ذ ر ز س ش ص ض ط ظ ع غ ف ق ك ل م ن ه و ي
alphabet.letters_latin: a b t th j h kh d dh r z s sh s d t z gh f q k l m n h w y
alphabet.note: Arabic has 28 letters, all consonants. Short vowels are shown as diacritical marks (harakat). Letters change shape depending on position in a word.
alphabet.letter_forms: Each letter has 4 forms: isolated, initial, medial, final.
alphabet.pronunciation_guide: Emphatic consonants (ص ض ط ظ) affect vowel quality. ع and غ are pharyngeal/uvular sounds unique to Arabic.
